an8.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an8.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.10:1.3: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an8.10:2.6: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ,
an8.10:2.7: yāv' assa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti;
an8.10:2.8: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tam enaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:2.10: Tam enaṃ iti viditvā bahiddhā nāsenti.
an8.10:2.12: Mā aññe bhaddake bhikkhū dūsesī ti. 3.
an8.10:3.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave sampanne yavakaraṇe yavadūsī jāyetha yavapalāpo yavakāraṇḍavo,
an8.10:3.2: tassa tādisaṃ yeva mūlaṃ hoti, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ.
an8.10:3.3: Tādisaṃ yeva nālaṃ hoti, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ,
an8.10:3.4: tādisaṃ yeva pattaṃ hoti, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ,
an8.10:3.6: yato ca khvāssa sīsaṃ nibbattati, tam enaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:3.8: Tam enaṃ iti viditvā samūlaṃ uppāṭetvā bahiddhā yavakaraṇassa chaḍḍenti.
an8.10:3.10: Mā aññe bhaddake yave dūsesī ti. Evaṃ
an8.10:4.1: eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ,
an8.10:4.2: yāv' assa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti;
an8.10:4.3: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tam enaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:4.5: Tam enaṃ iti viditvā bahiddhā nāsenti.
an8.10:4.7: Mā aññe bhaddake bhikkhū dūsesī ti. 4.
an8.10:5.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave mahato dhaññarāsissa vuvahyamānassa tattha yāni tāni dhaññāni daḷhāni sāravantāni, tāni ekamantaṃ puñjo hoti; yāni pana tāni dhaññāni dubbalāni palāpāni, tāni vāto ekamantaṃ apavahati.
an8.10:5.2: Tam enaṃ sāmikā sammajjaniṃ gahetvā bhiyyosomattāya apasammajjanti.
an8.10:5.4: Mā aññe bhaddake dhaññe dūsesī ti. Evam
an8.10:5.5: eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ,
an8.10:5.6: yāv' assa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti;
an8.10:5.7: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tam enaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:5.9: Tam enaṃ iti viditvā bahiddhā nāsenti.
an8.10:5.11: Mā aññe bhaddake bhikkhū dūsesī ti. 5.
an8.10:6.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso udapānapanāliyā atthiko tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya,
an8.10:6.2: so taṃ tad eva rukkhaṃ kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭeti. Tattha yāni tāni rukkhāni daḷhāni sāravantāni, tāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni kakkhaḷaṃ paṭinadanti;
an8.10:6.3: yāni pana tāni rukkhāni antopūtīni avassutāni kasambujātāni, tāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni daddaraṃ paṭinadanti.
an8.10:6.4: Tam enaṃ mūle chindati, mūle chinditvā agge chindati, agge chinditvā anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheti, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā udapānapanāliṃ yojeti.
an8.10:6.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathā pi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ,
an8.10:6.6: yāv' assa bhikkhū āpattiṃ na passanti;
an8.10:6.7: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti, tam enaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:6.9: Tam enaṃ iti viditvā bahiddhā nāsenti.
an8.10:6.11: Mā aññe bhaddake bhikkhū dūsesī ti.
